factChecks.fact: screen with a visible waveform trace must be clearly depicted -- the defining recognition feature
factChecks.note: Clear cyan sine-wave trace visible on the CRT-style graticule screen.
Front panel with vertical/horizontal/trigger control sections, BNC input connectors -- a genuine bench oscilloscope form.

prohibitedChangeChecks.prohibition: do not make one manufacturer's product appearance canonical
prohibitedChangeChecks.note: Generic grey/black instrument styling, no manufacturer logo.

styleComplianceNotes: Screen area is dark (its own display, an acceptable narrow exception), surrounding body is light grey/white per the style guide. Label "OSCILLOSCOPE" present.
